trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the medial portions of the trailing edge, tapering to acute, slightly rounded lateral tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, deeply incised sawtooth topography along the trailing edge of both lobes.
